import os, hashlib, subprocess

def Run(ctx, a):
    p = "index.html"
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    text = data.decode("utf-8")
    lines = text.splitlines()
    ps = subprocess.run(["ps", "-eo", "pid,args"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    return {
        "files": sorted(os.listdir(".")),
        "size": len(data),
        "lines": len(lines),
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16],
        "head": lines[:12],
        "tail": lines[-8:],
        "markers": {
            "localStorage_key": 'STORAGE_KEY = "todos.v1"' in text,
            "submit_handler": 'form.addEventListener("submit"' in text,
            "toggle_handler": 'list.addEventListener("change"' in text,
            "delete_handler": 'button.delete' in text,
            "load_on_start": 'var todos = load();' in text,
            "no_external_assets": ("http://" not in text and "https://" not in text and "src=" not in text),
        },
        "stray_chromium": [l for l in ps.splitlines() if "remote-debugging-port=9333" in l],
    }
